company.name: Norm AI
company.shortDescription: Norm AI develops AI software that embeds legal reasoning into AI agents to automate legal and compliance tasks.
company.description: Norm AI develops AI software that embeds legal reasoning into AI agents to automate legal and compliance tasks. Its offerings include legal AI agents, supervisory AI for verifying AI systems under legal requirements, legal engineering services, and an affiliated law firm that combines legal practice with AI development. The company also conducts research through its Legal AGI Lab to advance AI systems that operate within human legal frameworks.
